card.label: H.J.Res. 35
card.summary: H.J. Res. 35 is a joint resolution that disapproves and nullifies an Environmental Protection Agency rule concerning a waste emissions charge for petroleum and natural gas systems, effectively eliminating the annual waste emissions charge on certain oil or gas facilities under the Methane Emissions Reduction Program.
card.title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to "Waste Emissions Charge for Petroleum and Natural Gas Systems: Procedures for Facilitating Compliance, Including Netting and Exemptions".
